bio.text: Natalie Fleming is an independent candidate for U.S. Senate in Idaho in 2026; in the Idaho Capital Sun voter guide she lists her background as software developer and supply chain specialist.
According to her campaign website, she was born in Oregon, attended Moscow High School in Idaho, and began her career in the technology industry at WordPerfect and then Novell.

Her website says she raised four children in the Treasure Valley and later earned degrees in information technology management and supply chain management, with a minor in cybersecurity, at Boise State University.
